=== Other ===

* Historically, chance of obtaining from any resource node when using [[Frostbitten Toolbox#Contents|Frostbitten tools]]
* Historically, 1-3 were be obtained when combining 2 [[Mystic Coin]]s with any Tonics from the [[Bottle-Shaped Present]]
